feedback: No race has run yet, so there is no earlier telemetry to cite. Judged on its contents, the candidate is valid: all sensor positions, the sensor size, the wheel, body and mass values, and the controller fields fall inside the contract limits, and the five sensor weights are within [-2, 2]. The outer sensors at x = ±0.02 m sit near the tape edge (half-width 0.0125 m), so they may read nothing on tight bends, which makes line_loss_events the next thing to check. Kp 3 with a 350 PWM-per-unit turn gain is a firm but not extreme correction. Race it as the baseline and set the next revision from what the telemetry shows. If steering_oscillation or max_error is high, lower kp (for example to 2.0) or raise kd (for example to 0.3) before changing anything else. If completion_time is near or above 3.0 s with progress short of 1, raise base_speed (for example to 1.8) and watch max_error. If line_loss_events is above zero on the s-bend or slalom, widen the sensor span (for example x = ±0.03 m) or make the outer sensor weights larger in magnitude before changing the gains.
requested_changes: No earlier race exists, so this is a contingent plan. If steering_oscillation or max_error is high on the race, reduce kp to about 2.0 or raise kd to about 0.3.
If completion is 0 or completion_time is near 3.0 s with progress below 1, raise base_speed to about 1.8 and recheck max_error and line_loss_events.
If line_loss_events is above 0 on the s-bend or slalom, widen the outer sensors to x = ±0.03 m or enlarge the outer weights, keeping sensor_weights within [-2, 2].
